svg.title: PARTICLE FIGHTERS // SWITCH 1 // TRIGGER-COMBO CONTROLS // 3D PARTICLE CLOUD

g.text: L / R BUMPER (or D-PAD LEFT/RIGHT) = CHOOSE FIGHTER
ZR = ARENA DUEL (tekken cam) · ZL = OPEN WORLD SPIDER WAVES
ZR jab · ZR,ZR uppercut · ZL kick · ZL,ZL leaping spin roundhouse
L+ZR dash strike · R+ZL air kick · ZL+ZR character special
R blast · R,R ground slam · hold L block · L,L backstep dodge
L+R ULTIMATE (60 energy) · L3 jump · R3 cycle camera · L3+R3 menu
D-PAD CROSS = MOVE · right stick orbit camera (chase / overhead cams)
Keyboard test: WASD move J=ZR K=ZL U=L I=R Space=L3 C=R3 arrows=cam
Cameras: TEKKEN · CHASE · CINEMA ORBIT · OVERHEAD · LOW HERO
